title: CHARLI3 - Cardano integrated Side-Chain Oracle built on Substrate

problem: Builders require the same accurate and reliable data feeds (e.g. ADA / USD), but custom decentralized oracle price feeds are expensive and in-house solutions lack the focus of a dedicated solution
solution:
**Priority 1:** Provide 30-50 FREE oracle network price feeds through our existing Charli3 ecosystem, all in 2-3 months.

**Priority 2:** Create DAO to determine what feeds the ecosystem wants to launch.
title: CHARLI3 - Off-Chain & CNT Price Feeds (Community feed expansion)

problem: Lack of Python-based tools for developers to efficiently interact with multiple decentralized exchanges (DEXs) on Cardano.
solution: We will develop an open-source Python SDK to facilitate seamless interaction with multiple Cardano DEXs, enabling easy integration for Python developers
title: CHARLI3 - Open Source Multi-DEX SDK: A Pythonic Gateway to Decentralized Exchanges on Cardano

problem: Protocols want real-time data from an oracle solution at specific times, but our current solution only has on triggering mechanism for price deviations (e.g. if price fluctuates by 1%).
solution: Our current solution only triggers posting an on-chain data value when price deviates, we propose to add more triggering events, such as a direct call from a DeFi protocol (e.g. request current data).
title: CHARLI3 - "pull oracle" real-time price feeds on request (On Demand Validation service MVP)

problem: We recently upgraded to our third generation decentralized oracle architecture, led by the development at Mlabs. It is an evolution of our 2nd gen architecture previously audited by [CertiK](https://skynet.certik.com/projects/charli3) (level 2).
solution: We will contract a reliable lab ([Anastasia](https://anastasialabs.com/) and [CertiK](https://www.certik.com/) are viable options) to do a full audit of our on-chain code, off-chain code, and node software. Audits range from 75-150k + inhouse work.

problem: Centralized seed storage compromises user control, introducing single points of failure and reliance on trust in security.
solution: Our novel solution ensures user autonomy by encrypting and storing HD wallet seed phrases on the secure and decentralized Cardano Blockchain in a way that is user-friendly and easy to recover.

problem: Smart contract-enabled systems have ushered in a new era of innovation. Yet, alongside boundless opportunities, such systems have introduced significant risks and are extremely vulnerable to exploits
solution: Proposing 'Security Oracles': An active defense approach to smart contract security, offering real-time safety data to fortify smart contract-enabled systems *on Cardano*.
title: Security Oracles - a new approach to active Smart Contracts security

problem: Many believe hardware wallets are the final, most ideal form of self-custody and sovereign key management. Physical security of seed backups remains a weak link, making self-sovereignty hard at scale.
solution: This proposal protects keys from physical loss, theft, fire, flood, and war by encrypting them with HW-bound keys on multiple Yubikeys, then replicating them geographically. The MVP is an Android app.
title: Seed phrase backup using Yubikeys
